Calm handling explained before departure
This article covers the basics for visitors
Pet lounge route basics

Keep your pet close, keep your documents ready, and move through the route without rushing. The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways is there to keep the handoff smooth, so follow the calm flow and listen for staff guidance at each point.

Before you reach the lounge, settle your carrier, water bowl, and leash or harness in one easy check. If your pet is nervous, speak softly and avoid sudden movements. A welcome team prepares passengers for boarding. That steady start helps everyone stay on track and avoids last-minute trouble.

At Ashenfell, <<FACT F006>>. Keep your focus on the handoff, stay with the route, and let staff take the lead if your pet needs extra settling. Do not split up from your pet unless a staff member asks you to step aside for review.

At Vellmar, <<FACT F020>>. Arrive prepared, follow the posted flow, and give yourself a little extra room for calm handling. If the line slows, that is normal, and the safest move is to wait and keep your pet comfortable.

If a concern comes up, the review moves step by step and stays practical. That means staff check the issue, give clear direction, and only escalate when needed. It is better to pause early than to push ahead and create more stress.

For more help, contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk through Aurelia Skyways customer support before you travel.
